summary: E17 hardening full sweep (backend + frontend). Ran 60 pytest cases across tests/test_hardening_e17.py, test_catalog_v2.py, test_sales_flow.py, test_email_notify_e15.py, test_shipment_e16.py → 59 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failures (one transient network timeout self-recovered on retry). UI verified: server-side search drawer, wishlist via ?ids= (guest+mobile), customer logout revocation, brute-force 429, anti-SSRF from-url, strict admin config schema.

minor.issue: Public read still lives at GET /api/stores (not /api/store-config); admin GET returns detail schema. Not a bug, but worth documenting so frontend/lokasi keeps calling /api/stores.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminVoucherInput used with model_dump(exclude_unset=True) — correct pattern for partial updates; keep required fields optional where partial edit is expected, otherwise dialog must submit full body.
net_guard blocks 127.0.0.1/localhost/link-local/private-10.x with Indonesian message and 400 — good. Consider also blocking 172.16.0.0/12 and 192.168.0.0/16 for completeness (verify).

verified_ui_flows.search_drawer: server debounce OK, result-count 'N Hasil untuk “q”', see-all appears for q='a' (>8), navigates to /shop?q=a with removable chip shop-active-filter-q
verified_ui_flows.wishlist_guest_desktop_mobile: Add via product-card-wishlist-button, /wishlist calls GET /api/products?ids=... (verified 2 requests seen), renders 2 cards on both 1920 and 390 viewports; order preserved (matches LS array)
verified_ui_flows.customer_logout_revocation: Login at /akun stores token under cp:token:v1; click Keluar; old bearer → /api/auth/me returns 401
verified_ui_flows.brute_force_lockout: Registered throwaway bf<ts>@example.com; wrong pwd 1-5 → 401 (Indonesian 'Email atau kata sandi salah'); 6th+7th → 429 Retry-After: 900 with 'Terlalu banyak percobaan masuk. Coba lagi dalam 15 menit.'
verified_ui_flows.admin_config_strict: PUT /api/admin/settings and PUT /api/admin/store-config with unknown field → 422; PUT /api/admin/store-config with store_rating_avg/store_rating_count/stores_intro → 200
